name: SSH
description: Provides secure access to remote servers over SSH using configured connection settings.

commands.title: Connect to a server over SSH
commands.description: Connects to a remote server over SSH using the configured settings. Host, username, and password config values are environment-variable names only; never ask for or expose their values. Use this command to carry out tasks the user requests on that server.

commands.title: Upload a file to the SSH server
commands.description: Upload a local file to the configured server over SFTP. Input must include localPath (an absolute path on this computer) and remotePath. Existing destination files are not overwritten unless overwrite is explicitly true.

commands.title: Download a file from the SSH server
commands.description: Download a remote file from the configured server over SFTP. Input must include remotePath and localPath (an absolute destination path on this computer). Existing destination files are not overwritten unless overwrite is explicitly true.

config.label: SSH host environment variable name
config.description: Name of the environment variable containing the remote server hostname or IP address. Enter the variable name only, not its value.

config.label: SSH username environment variable name
config.description: Name of the environment variable containing the SSH username. Enter the variable name only, not its value.

config.label: SSH port
config.description: SSH service port on the remote server.

config.label: SSH password environment variable name
config.description: Name of the environment variable containing the SSH password. Enter the variable name only, not its value.

config.label: SSH private key path
config.description: Optional path to the private key file used for authentication. Configure the key on this computer; do not paste private key contents here. If set, it is used instead of the password.

config.label: SSH private key passphrase environment variable name
config.description: Optional name of the environment variable containing the private key passphrase. Enter the variable name only, not its value.

config.label: .env file path
config.description: Path to the .env file containing the SSH environment variables.
